taskTemplate.name: Order FraudX
taskTemplate.description: Order the FraudX report and add every transaction party that must be screened

subTaskTemplate.name: Buyer Agent
subTaskTemplate.description: Buyer Agent – Add the buyer's agent to the FraudX order. Add this subtask only for purchase transactions.

subTaskTemplate.name: Seller Agent
subTaskTemplate.description: Seller Agent – Add the seller's agent to the FraudX order. Add this subtask only for purchase transactions.

subTaskTemplate.name: Sellers
subTaskTemplate.description: Sellers – Add all sellers to the FraudX order. Add this subtask only for purchase transactions.

subTaskTemplate.name: Order
subTaskTemplate.description: Order – Submit the FraudX order once every party has been added; marking Done will place the FraudX order
